title: Turn Signal Stalk and BC Button
summary: Feedback on the turn signal stalk centers on appreciation for physical stalk controls, complaints about missing BC-button functions and turn signal behavior, and many snippets that are too brief or off-topic to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the physical turn signal stalk controls, including easy access to high-beam activation and favorable mention of the stalk as an interior touchpoint.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about the loss of BC-button access to odometer functions through the stalk and a right turn signal that sometimes stays on.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention the turn signal stalk, BC button, signal behavior, or unrelated worries, but many lack enough context for a clear sentiment judgment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the concrete sentiment evidence is limited.
Several undetermined fragments are too short to interpret reliably.
Some examples appear loosely related or unrelated to the turn signal stalk topic, including worries about windshield quality or range estimation.
